newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key JGB futures fall below 123 amid correction.
newsitem.headline: Key JGB futures fall below 123 amid correction.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond futures contract dropped to close below 123 on Monday for the first time in more than a week, with its seven-day rally corrected by profit-taking.
The December contract became a target of profit-taking after it had continued to rally without cash JGBs following them during the past several days, dealers said.

Dealers said the overall bullish market trend has not changed but that a break below 123 may imply dimmer prospects for the contract in the near term. The December contract closed at 122.85, down 0.48 from Friday. Volume was 40,826 contracts.
